[rb-chk-01] :: Before finalizing, re-read the original request and confirm every explicit requirement and constraint (each named element, format, scope, and limit) is present and satisfied. Independence is the point: a check that merely restates the reasoning that produced the answer catches nothing — the second path must be able to disagree with the first.
